name: Illegal Gambling and Match-Fixing
description: Operation of unlicensed betting, underground casinos and online gambling, and manipulation of sporting events for betting profit. Money is laundered through bets, payment processors and agents, with corruption of athletes or officials.

sources.text: FATF and APG, Vulnerabilities of Casinos and Gaming Sector (2009)
FATF, Money Laundering through the Football Sector (2009)
Council of Europe, Convention on the Manipulation of Sports Competitions (2014)
Closest: FATF/APG, Vulnerabilities of Casinos and Gaming Sector (2009); FATF, Risks of Gaming and Gambling (2026)

exposure.rationale: Betting payments via card/bank to disguised merchants, nested processors, e-wallets and crypto.

indicators.name: Payments to unlicensed gambling operators or via nested processors
indicators.canon: Unlicensed or cloned operator receiving payments
indicators.desc: Payments go to operators, platforms or merchants that are absent from regulatory registers, imitate a legitimate firm, or process under a disguised merchant category.
indicators.ctx: Card or bank payments to merchants disguised under other categories.

indicators.name: Many accounts funding a few betting accounts or agents
indicators.canon: Many unrelated senders paying a single account or recipient
indicators.desc: Numerous unrelated payers send frequent, often small, payments to one account, wallet or beneficiary, or one funder pays many beneficiaries, with no clear commercial relationship.
indicators.ctx: Pooling of funds to bookmakers or agents.

indicators.name: Bets with minimal risk, such as opposing outcomes at different books
indicators.canon: Bets with minimal risk, such as opposing outcomes at different books
indicators.desc: Low-risk betting and quick withdrawals to launder.
indicators.ctx: Low-risk betting and quick withdrawals to launder.

indicators.name: Unusual betting patterns on lower-league or youth matches
indicators.canon: Unusual betting patterns on lower-league or youth matches
indicators.desc: Large late stakes on obscure markets.
indicators.ctx: Large late stakes on obscure markets.

indicators.name: Players or officials receive payments from betting-linked parties
indicators.canon: Players or officials receive payments from betting-linked parties
indicators.desc: Payments to athletes, referees from unrelated parties.
indicators.ctx: Payments to athletes, referees from unrelated parties.

indicators.name: Deposits and withdrawals with little betting activity
indicators.canon: Large buy-in or deposits with little underlying activity
indicators.desc: Substantial funds are deposited or bought in with minimal gambling or betting activity before withdrawal.
indicators.ctx: Account used as e-wallet with minimal play.
indicators.fp: Players may deposit and cash out.

indicators.name: Underground casino or card house with cash and chip sales
indicators.canon: Underground casino or card house with cash and chip sales
indicators.desc: Cash-heavy venue with transfers by chat apps.
indicators.ctx: Cash-heavy venue with transfers by chat apps.

indicators.name: Use of crypto and prepaid cards for gambling top-ups
indicators.canon: Use of crypto and prepaid cards for gambling top-ups
indicators.desc: Layering via crypto into betting accounts.
indicators.ctx: Layering via crypto into betting accounts.
indicators.fp: Crypto betting is legal in places.
